title: The same package whose installer installs hashed requirements and makes no other request (clean control)

proof.python:
s = open('install.sh').read()
assert 'curl' not in s and 'env' not in s.replace('--no-input', '') and 'pip install --no-input --no-build-isolation .' in s
import tomllib
assert tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml', 'rb'))['project']['dependencies'] == []
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
